reason: My nephew in India handles these things and I usually just wait for my next trip to sort the bank. I have never paid a stranger online to move big money, and a flat sale is not something I rush.
objection: Why pay a company when family already does it for nothing? And with flat-sale money I would want to know who exactly holds it in between, and who I phone if something goes wrong.
would_change_my_mind: If my nephew could not do it, or my CA told me this exact route is the proper way for flat sale proceeds and a person I could phone confirmed it, I would try it.
